replies.author: kon333
replies.body:
The outside looks great! For improvements i would say change the diamond to iron as it could lead to kill farming and over powered rushes, especially in the vault. 

You could possibly add more texture to the stone by adding stone bricks or cobblestone etc.

Finally i would add middle islands because from the photo the void space seems rather big, possibly leading to stalemate gameplay with lots of bow spamming. 

Some extra pictures would be good!

replies.author: kon333
replies.body: Forgot to say something sorry. The outside looks very nice but i feel like it is missing something. You could maybe add a beach or a hill or something outside the vault door, as the massive rush to get out will cause a lot of deaths. So maybe have what i said up there to allow a bigger space for people to start building and to avoid all the "fell into the void"
